name: Harm Trap — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Harm Trap from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Harm Trap (CR 10)" but are not part of the Harm Trap entry, which is unchanged.

Visitors approaching within 10 feet of the trap trigger a permanent magic mouth, which addresses them in Aklo: “To the hallowed halls you come. Speak now the liturgy for solace and you may enter unbitten and unscathed.”

Those who fail to give the proper password in Aklo before opening the doors trigger a terrible trap as arcane energy lashes out of the doors at intruders. The password is, “Sanctum sought, the Primal Coil praised.”

Type magic; Notice Perception DC 31; Disable Disable Device DC 31

Pathfinder Adventure Path #42: Sanctum of the Serpent God. © 2011, Paizo Publishing, LLC; Author: Neil Spicer.
